basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software engineer based in Toronto, Canada. I have a keen interest in gaming, specifically SEKIRO, and I'm always on the lookout for the latest in technology and software developments. In my free time, I enjoy reading up on wildlife facts and incorporating humor into everyday life. I'm typically online in the evenings after work, and I love sharing jokes and puns to brighten someone's day. I'm currently in a long-term relationship and we both share a love for exploring new cuisines and traveling.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the software development field for over a decade. My expertise is largely self-taught, supplemented by years of experience in the industry. I have a strong foundation in programming languages and enjoy participating in tech forums to expand my knowledge.
